name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace Warm Buttermilk Cornbread Side
brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Fine-milled Southern buttermilk cornbread baked without whole corn kernels or jalapeños makes an easy, low-fiber side with roasted chicken.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a side of Buttermilk Cornbread alongside plain steamed white rice and roasted chicken.
watchOuts: Contains buttermilk and butter—take lactase if sensitive
